scope: Features page (/features), brought up to public v1.52.0 on November 23, 2026: nine smaller-details tiles and their popovers for features shipped from v1.39.0 to v1.51.0 (Split View, Reader Mode, Favorites folders, Auto-hide the Island, Mini Window, Tab Archive, Shared Spaces, Send to Device, protected video), and the Blanc Spaces badge. Every evidence path is at the publicRelease tag. Popover wording follows each feature’s owner-approved What’s New highlight, re-checked against v1.52.0 (Favorites now opens in a tab; Send to Device no longer names the retired Ledger layout). Tile and popover icons are decorative. The sample group names in the tile mock-ups now keep their capital letters, as group names have since v1.37.0.

splitView.qualification: Split with in a tab menu pairs it with another tab; in v1.52.0 a split holds two panes (PR1_MAX_PANES). The focused pane is the active tab, splits persist in session.json, and Remove from Split / Close Split end it.

readerMode.qualification: /reader or Enter Reader Mode in the expanded Island; extraction runs locally on the loaded page and keeps headings, links, images and tables; leaving restores the page without reloading; non-articles are reported and left unchanged.

favorites.qualification: Since v1.51.0 Favorites opens as a page in a tab with folders in a sidebar; folder paths nest; drag reorders favorites and folders; search covers every folder; deleting a folder moves its contents up rather than deleting them.

autoHide.qualification: Auto-hide the Island is a Settings → General switch, off by default; the page fills the window and the Island returns on pointing at the top edge or Cmd/Ctrl+L.

miniWindow.qualification: File → New Mini Window, or an opt-in global shortcut (off by default) in Settings → General; never saved; closes after an hour unused (MINI_WINDOW_IDLE_MS) unless a page is in use or has unsaved work; Open in Blanc keeps it as an ordinary window.

tabArchive.qualification: Archive inactive tabs in Settings → General (12 hours, 1 day, 7 days, 30 days; off by default); loose tabs close into a device-local Archive kept 30 days, shown in the ⌘L panel and History; pinned, grouped, split and private tabs are never archived.

sharedSpaces.qualification: Settings → Sync → Spaces and groups, per device and off by default, Personal profile only; shared Spaces keep tabs, tab names, groups and pinned tabs in step, end-to-end encrypted like the rest of Sync; private tabs never sync.

sendToDevice.qualification: Send to Device in the tab menu or /send; items wait under Sent to this device and expire 7 days after sending (ITEM_TTL_MS); nothing opens automatically; needs Profile Sync on both devices; private tabs and internal pages cannot be sent.

protectedVideo.qualification: castLabs ECS runtime with the Widevine CDM component, downloaded from Google in the background, on macOS, Windows and Linux; playback depends on each site (Netflix and Spotify tried on Apple Silicon for v1.43.0).

spacesAcrossProfiles.qualification: With two or more profiles the Spaces menu and Quick Switcher list every profile’s Spaces under profile headings; choosing one opens it in a window of that profile.
